reviews.text: The cat's senior check-up went very well. The schedule was kept. The service was friendly and knowledgeable. The price was also reasonable!
We received excellent help with our dog's anxiety. The quality of the service and the price list are on point!

We went for a pregnancy x-ray at Lazloveti with Ilona Hiidenmies from ELL. We received a detailed x-ray report and an unurgent health check-up, and the doctor kindly agreed to my request to consult Lazlo, who has always interpreted our images before. The course of the birth fully corresponded to the report, meaning it was not completely problem-free. I am 100% satisfied with our appointment - and I think the price was affordable.
I have already told my friends. Very professional and good Veterinarian! Eko feels like he is home when he gets help!

I accidentally called the wrong number. A rude male voice told me I was taking their money because I clicked on an ad they paid for while searching for the number on Google.
Thanks for the advice, I know which number to call in the future, no matter what!😂👍🏻
Excellent and professional service, easy to find appointments and reasonable price. We went for tartar removal for our dog and everything went as expected. Thank you!
On February 4, 2026, I had my little Nana spayed at this clinic! They treated us very well, and everything went smoothly! I highly recommend this place for your pets.
The cat's sterilization was affordable and everything went smoothly. Thank you for the good service 🐱❤️ …
My favorite vet to take my dogs. Been using Veteira for as long as I can remember.

I've been coming here for a year because of my cat's urinary tract infections and stress, because the situation just didn't get better and in the end none of the doctors could offer any help.
I made an appointment with another company and it turned out that it wasn't necessarily an infection at all, because the urine samples were taken by squeezing, meaning the bacteria could have come from the skin or hair into the sample.
Now the sample was taken directly from the bladder and there was no bacterial infection there. The blood samples showed incipient hyperthyroidism.
How did none of the vet's doctors realize to take blood tests? I myself blindly trusted the professional's opinion.

Luckily I realized to go to a competent doctor's office who took blood tests and questioned previous diagnoses.
All I left with from the vet was a bad feeling and an empty wallet. I guess they are quite competent in simple things, like removing tartar and doing health checks.
Doctors also price visits according to their own preferences, a visit to one doctor is €100 and another is €200, even though the procedures are completely the same, at the same company.
Very professional and friendly, the price for the consultation and vaccinations seemed fair and the service was excellent. It was our first time, but they will definitely be our regular vet.
